correctness.rationale: Exact claim is the integral geometric reflection-fixed homotopy type of Ind_r(P_n) for all integers n,r>=1, not fixed vertices or equivariant homotopy of the ambient. Barycentric fixed coordinates are constant on two-element reversal orbits and the central singleton, identifying the fixed locus PL with K(m;r,floor(r/2)) for n=2m and Y=K(m;r,r) union c*K(m;r,floor((r-1)/2)) for n=2m+1. The bound at the seam follows from doubling a terminal occupied run, or doubling plus one with center selected. In both orbit-face families, toggling the first paired coordinate matches a downward-closed subposet; directed cross-boundary Hasse edges cannot form a cycle, and unmatched faces contain r forced following vertices and omit the separator r+2, leaving the same smaller model, lifting critical dimensions by r. Base cases 0<=m<=r+1 yield a unique augmented critical face at the two stated remainders, otherwise no augmented critical face. With the augmented empty-face convention this proves sphere/contractible homotopy integrally, including r=1,n=2 empty S^-1, S^0 two points, and n=1 point; it is not an extrapolation from experiments. Independently reconstructed Git root and verification subtree SHAs from actual tree entries, read all seven source blobs and verification script/log. Independent finite checks constructed original-orbit admissible face sets, computed model faces, recursive matching, full directed Hasse acyclicity for 240 pairs n=1..24,r=1..10, and reduced F2 homology for 150 pairs n=1..15,r=1..10, all agreeing. These are corroboration, not the infinite proof. No substantive logical gap found.
